note: The API and the tool protocol are two axes: every row here is api=responses on tool_protocol=native. The rows of cases.json keep their wires; none of them is read as a Responses tool protocol. Each row's expectation is the same calls on Chat Completions, run in the same test as the control, or a golden recorded before this feature; nothing here is generated from the Responses implementation.

rows.expect: the request's parameters are the adopted schema and the Chat Completions parameters, strict=false on the schema tool only; the executor receives the raw value unchanged
every rejected row of cases.json and one past each limit: zero executions, the Chat Completions refusal text, arguments "{}" on the next request, and the raw text nowhere in it
every schema call of the reply is refused as duplicate_key
outputs in the reply's order, each call with its own receipt, as on Chat Completions
reasoning, preamble, unknown item, and call go back once in their order
a refused call, a reshaped call, or a dummy secret in the preamble, the reasoning summary, or an unknown item: the turn is the host's call alone, and the dummy secret is in no request
the retry feedback up to the existing limit, then the error; the same event names as malformed native calls on Chat Completions; never XML

id_errors: a schema call and another call in the reply
two other calls in the reply
a missing one after a good one
another call held before, then a schema call
another call held before, then another call
